title: Granola testimonials
description: A charcoal band with a centred serif heading and a sideways row of large square-cornered quote cards outlined in a thin white line. Each card: a small company wordmark, a big serif quote with a hanging opening mark, the speaker's name and role, and a square greyscale portrait at the bottom right (under the quote on phones). The row starts at the content edge, runs off the right, and snaps as you swipe.
notes: carries the dark class itself (charcoal under the light theme)
portraits are square slots; empty, a plain muted square
plain horizontal scroll with snap: no JavaScript, no autoplay
name: granola-testimonials
